description_en: Queries the price information of a resource
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-resource-price --node-instance-type appstreaming.vgpu.4c8g.2g --product-type CloudApp --charge-type PrePaid --period 1 --period-unit Week --amount 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-instance-type appstreaming.general --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetResourcePrice

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource specification type to purchase. You can obtain this value by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428502.html operation.

Either AppInstanceType or NodeInstanceType must have a value. If both have values, NodeInstanceType is used
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的规格类型ID，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428502.html接口获取。

AppInstanceType与NodeInstanceType其中一个必须有值。若两个都有值则使用NodeInstanceType
parameters.name: node_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The numeric part of the resource purchase duration. This parameter is used together with PeriodUnit to specify the complete purchase duration
parameters.help_zh: 资源购买时长的数量部分，与`PeriodUnit`一起表示完整的购买时长
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit part of the resource purchase duration. This parameter is used together with Period to specify the complete purchase duration. Valid combinations of Period and PeriodUnit:

1 Week (1 week)
1 Month (1 month)
2 Month (2 months)
3 Month (3 months)
6 Month (6 months)
1 Year (1 year)
2 Year (2 years)
3 Year (3 years)

This parameter is case-sensitive. For example, `Week` is valid, but `week` is invalid. If the request parameters do not match the combinations listed above, such as `2 Week`, the call to this operation succeeds, but an error occurs during the order placement phase
parameters.help_zh:
资源购买时长的单位部分，与`Period`一起表示完整的购买时长。可使用的`Period`与`PeriodUnit`的搭配如下：

1 Week（1周）
1 Month（1个月）
2 Month（2个月）
3 Month（3个月）
6 Month（6个月）
1 Year（1年）
2 Year（2年）
3 Year（3年）

该参数区分大小写。例如，`Week`是有效的，`week`是无效的。另外，如果请求参数不符合上述搭配，例如`2 Week`，虽然调用本接口会成功，但最终在下单阶段会出错
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The quantity of resources to purchase
parameters.name: amount

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the delivery group. For more information about supported regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html
parameters.help_zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。关于支持的地域详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the session specification type to purchase. You can obtain this value by calling the `ListAppInstanceType` operation.

Either AppInstanceType or NodeInstanceType must have a value. If both have values, NodeInstanceType is used
parameters.help_zh:
购买会话的规格类型ID，可通过`ListAppInstanceType`接口获取。

AppInstanceType与NodeInstanceType其中一个必须有值。若两个都有值则使用NodeInstanceType
parameters.name: app_instance_type
